# Check coverage

<!-- generated by checks/tools/gen-coverage.py on 2026-09-24 - do not edit by hand -->

**9 of 348 scenarios are proven** — played on the running application.

13 more are checked without being proven: the running system was queried, or the build was read, but the scenario itself was not played. A patch can be green at build time and have no effect at runtime, which is exactly what those levels miss. They are useful feedback and they are not proof, so they are counted apart rather than folded into one number.

| level | scenarios | what it means |
|---|---|---|
| measured | 9 | the scenario was played on the running application |
| observed | 13 | the running system was queried, the scenario was not played |
| inspected | 0 | the build was read, nothing ran |
| none | 326 | no check names this scenario |
